ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region and inner lobes dominated by a contiguous low-intensity black mass. Distal regions of both lobes transition into high-intensity white zones, with the right lobe possessing a larger, more uniform high-intensity area than the left.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped notch with an approximate interior angle of 70-75 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the entire visible trailing edge, characterized by irregular pixel-amplitude peaks. Maximum topographical irregularity and jaggedness are concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curvature extending from the distal tips toward the central median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, irregular clusters of high-contrast pixels (mottled grey/white/tan) localized at the extreme distal points of the left and right lobes, consistent with encrustation patterns.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of approximately 6-8 distinct, parallel high-intensity linear streaks (rake marks) oriented vertically/obliquely across the pigmented dark region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive jagged degradation of the trailing edge boundary on the distal left lobe, indicating significant tissue loss or persistent barnacle load.
other_distinctive_markers: A single, isolated low-intensity circular pixel cluster (dark spot) located in the upper-medial quadrant of the high-intensity white area on the right lobe.
